name: duck

attributes.attribute: goddess of the source of the river Seine
animal of Sequana, shown as a boat-prow shape

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The duck acted as a symbol bird in Celtic tradition. It was the animal of Sequana, the goddess of the source of France's river Seine. Artists often showed Sequana sailing in a boat. The prow of that boat was shaped into a duck's head. Birds frequently stand for Celtic divinity. Goddesses draw this bird symbolism most often.
